title: Add a semantic label to the custom back IconButton in recent_activity_screen.dart
why: This is a hand-rolled header row, not AppBar's automatic leading back button, so Flutter supplies no implicit semantics label here. A screen-reader user (TalkBack/VoiceOver) tabbing to this control hears only 'button' with no indication it navigates back, on a screen reachable from every Progress-hub session.
recommendation: Add tooltip: l10n.<existing back-button key> (or a new ARB key) to the IconButton so it gets both a visible tooltip and a screen-reader label.
acceptance_criteria: A semantics test (or manual VoiceOver/TalkBack pass) confirms the back control announces a localized label.
